title: Perfectly preserved owl fossil from 47 million years ago could help to solve a major evolutionary mystery
caption:
A perfectly preserved 47-million-year-old owl fossil from Germany is rewriting what we know about when these birds became nocturnal. By analyzing its last meal and wing structure, researchers suggest these birds were once daytime hunters.

Source: Livescience - Perfectly preserved owl fossil from 47 million years ago could help to solve a major evolutionary mystery
